name: Stylist
tagline: What to wear, decided in 30 seconds, from the clothes you already own.
author: jarridxjackson

villain.name: The Closet Stare
villain.scene: You're standing in front of a full closet, late again, holding the same three things. It's cold, you have a client pitch, and nothing feels right.

whys.a: Tell it where you're going and the weather, and it gives you three outfits from your own clothes, with the reasons behind each.
Every morning decision costs focus you'd rather spend on the pitch, the date or the work.

whys.q: Why is it still a problem?
whys.a: Style apps show you clothes to buy. You need help with the clothes you already have.

whys.q: Why can't I just wing it?
whys.a: Winging it means the same outfit on repeat, the wrong layer for the weather, or showing up underdressed.
Add the ten things you wear most. Tomorrow morning is already decided.

save.basis: About 10 minutes a day spent deciding, cut to under 1 (roughly 20 hours a year), plus one or two impulse buys a year you skip because it tells you exactly which piece is missing.

howTo: Tap the clothes you own (or add your own)
Say where you're going and how warm it is
Pick one of three outfits and hit Wear this
pitch.bestFor: Anyone who dresses for different rooms: work, clients, dates, the gym

privacy: Your wardrobe stays on your device (browser storage). Nothing is uploaded.
